evaluation.feature_request: Add a simple health check endpoint at GET /health that returns { status: 'ok', uptime: process.uptime() }. Bypass auth middleware.

phase_0_0.rationale: Config file exists but lacks featureDev section. All featureDev defaults applied.

phase_0_1.decision: Would initialize team, blackboard, and task list
phase_0_1.rationale: Phase 0.1 only creates coordination infrastructure. No agents spawned.

phase_0_2.decision: Protocol template noted, no agents spawned
phase_0_2.verification: Skill explicitly states agents are spawned on-demand in their respective phases, not upfront

phase_1.rationale: Feature is fully specified: method, path, response shape, auth bypass. User explicitly closed scope with 'nothing fancy'. All six confidence criteria met without gaps.

proportionality_observations.explorer_count_concern: 3 explorers is disproportionate for a trivial single-endpoint feature
proportionality_observations.rationale: Feature has no ambiguity, no complex integration, no design trade-offs worth 3 competing architectures. One explorer and one architect would be sufficient.
proportionality_observations.skill_gap: Skill lacks dynamic scaling of agent count based on feature complexity assessed in Phase 1
